# vcell-chombo builds with Homebrew GCC on macOS, not Apple Clang.
#
# Chombo ships compiler definitions for GNU, Intel, IBM, PGI and others, but
# none for Clang (chombo/lib/mk/compiler/). Under Clang it falls back to bare
# defaults and loses the -C that Make.defs.GNU adds to the Fortran preprocessor
# step -- without which the preprocessor eats Fortran's // concatenation
# operator. The historical VCell macOS build used MacPorts GCC for the same
# reason.
#
# Chombo derives its compiler name as
#   cxxname = $(notdir $(firstword $(subst -, ,$(CXX))))
# so Homebrew's /opt/homebrew/bin/g++-13 correctly reduces to "g++" and matches its
# GNU rules. Verified on the runners rather than assumed.
#
# Note that Conan Center publishes no macOS binaries for a GCC profile, so
# every dependency is compiled from source here. That is the price of the above
# and is why the CI job runs with messaging off, which avoids OpenSSL.
#
# Version pinned to 13 to match conan-profiles/CI-CD/Linux-AMD64_profile.txt;
# the runners also carry 14, 15 and 16.
[settings]
arch=armv8
build_type=Release
compiler=gcc
compiler.version=13
compiler.libcxx=libstdc++11
compiler.cppstd=20
os=Macos

[conf]
# Required: conanfile.py's layout() only flattens the tree to build/generators
# when this is set. Without it, cmake_layout() emits build/Release/generators.
tools.cmake.cmaketoolchain:generator=Ninja

[options]
fPIC=True
shared=False
